payload.description_html:
Size comparison of the Upper Cretaceous Alabaman derived tyrannosauroid Appalachiosaurus montgomoriensis. The human silhouette is from File:Silhouette of man standing and facing forward.svg (CC0).

References

  • Carr, Thomas D.; Williamson, Thomas E.; Schwimmer, David R. (2005). "A new genus and species of tyrannosauroid from the Late Cretaceous (Middle Campanian) Demopolis Formation of Alabama". Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 25 (1): 119–143.
